evidence: Builder: telescope built from lightning rod, logs and fence by hand. Reviewer Minor Elements: telescope hard to read as a telescope at street level.

need: Eave fixtures should target cone brims and jetty corners, not only straight eave lines, and hang on chains.
evidence: Builder: hanging lanterns under the roof brim hand-placed with chain; fixtures-at-eaves could not target the cone brim or jetty corners.

need: The renderer should show lit windows as glowing, with a halo or emissive pass, so a lantern-lit window reads as lit rather than as an orange block.
evidence: Builder: no light engine, so glowing windows needed shroomlight or orange glass. Reviewer Minor Elements: glowing window reads as an orange block, hard to read as a window.

need: An ivy treatment that places vine blocks on a wall surface with strand continuation, clustering, and a density option.
evidence: Builder: ivy hand-looped with clustering and continuation; closest was vary. Reviewer Minor Facades: add ivy to the upper timber floors.

need: A landscaping brush that builds a rocky mound or plinth around a building base with a stair flight, sized to fit small footprints.
evidence: Builder: rocky mound with stair flight built with a hand height-field loop; landscaping brushes did not fit a 13x13 plinth. Reviewer Minor Facades: stone base blocky, odd extruded ground blocks.

need: A helper that lays a ladder run through a multi-floor shaft and adds the required backing blocks, so no ladder is left unsupported.
evidence: Builder: ladder through a multi-floor shaft needed hand-placed backing blocks; check flagged unsupported ladders.

need: The glance render should be able to show one-block detail at street distance, or flag detail edits that are too small to register there.
evidence: Rejected Detail tasks (x2): window and trim changes and panel tints were too small to read at distance, so the glance was unchanged.

need: Accept an explicit `--footprint x0,z0,x1,z1[;...]` on the CLI so detection on a roofless shell does not mistake awnings or stairs at roof height for an old roof.
evidence: Builder: --detect/--dry-run on a roofless shell mis-detected the footprint from awning stairs at y4; had to call roof() from code.

need: Let a preset's wind tower be placed on any footprint corner or centre and styled (size, height, cap) from the preset, not only switched off with `tower:false`.
evidence: Preset hard-codes a front-left 3x3 wind tower (height 2); builder hand-built it. Reviewer: 'dome or wind tower' reads as a pile of blocks.

need: Build the roof parapet from the preset or parapet brush; a builder should not dress a roof edge with fence or stair scraps, and the preset docs should say so.
evidence: Roof fence read as a pasture fence, not a parapet; the preset parapet was never used. Reviewer said to run `mcd roof --preset desert`.

need: Give dome a smooth profile for small radius on a short drum (r≈3 on 3 blocks) so it does not read as a stepped pyramid, plus a band or stripe option for a course of a different block.
evidence: Dome r=3 on a 3-tall budget reads as a stepped pyramid; the orange course was done by replacing stairs in a loop. Reviewer: 'lumpy heap of sandstone steps'.

need: Place a sloped, striped awning on a facade with a chosen run, pitch, stripe repeat and soffit, using stair or slab blocks so the stripes stay within the palette.
evidence: Awning placed by hand (stairs + slab soffit + fence posts + lanterns). Terracotta has no stairs, so stripes fell back to red_sandstone/quartz. Reviewer: 'awnings are chunky stair stacks'.

need: Allow one stair row with a clear stripe repeat (no stacking) as an awning option, so the awning reads light from 3/4 views.
evidence: Reviewer: awnings look heavy from 3/4 views; the builder used stair stacks. Folds into the awning brush.

need: Place a beam-end rhythm (log ends projecting from a wall top on any chosen faces) with variable spacing and projection, instead of identical blocks in a row.
evidence: Vigas hand-placed as dark_oak_log stubs; no brush (closest is `brackets`). Reviewer: identical viga squares in a regular row.

need: Build thick, rounded or chamfered wall shells on any plan (union of rects or a polygon) with per-skin material layering.
evidence: Thick rounded adobe on a non-rectangular plan: a union of two rects looped by hand; no per-skin material layering (closest is `shell`). Reviewer: walls read as sharp boxes.

need: Round or chamfer vertical corners of any massing box by a stated radius, with the same option for parapet corners.
evidence: Reviewer: 'plain rectangular slab with square corners'; 'harsh seam at the corner' of the parapet.

need: Add a coping or cap course of a different material and a solid fill option to the parapet, so the top edge has relief.
evidence: Parapet was a plain single-block terracotta ring with no coping. Reviewer: 'white parapet cap is stark'; asked for a sandstone or terracotta cap.

need: Paint a band on chosen rows (for example rows 2-3) across every face, not only every n rows.
evidence: Orange terracotta band round the building was a manual loop over skin cells; `paint courses` bands every n rows only.

need: Place a grouped cluster of market props (pots, baskets, barrels, hay, goods) at a chosen corner or pillar line, as one call.
evidence: Props hand-placed (decorated_pot, barrel, hay_block, composter); `planter` only does boxes and beds. Reviewer: props scattered at random.

need: Build an entrance stair-up and forecourt that keeps the interior floor level when the building floor is at y0.
evidence: No stair-up that keeps the interior floor level; builder had to hand-place entrance steps.

need: Let a builder declare a role as monochrome or an intentional outlier, so a deliberate single-material trim or stripe is not flagged as invisible.
evidence: mcd palette flagged the monochrome sandstone trim and quartz/orange awning stripes as invisible/outliers; no way to say 'monochrome by design'.

need: Render glass panes as opaque or tinted in elevations, so a window in both side walls does not read as a hole through the building.
evidence: Glass panes render see-through end to end in elevations; a window in both side walls looks like a hole through the building.

need: Default windows to a recess one block deep with sill and lintel trim, so openings read as recessed without hand placement.
evidence: Reviewer: 'no recessed openings', 'tiny windows'; builder left windows flush. Brief asked for sill and lintel trim.

need: Each tier can take a gabled top with its ridge on a chosen axis, so stacked tiers read as steep gabled slopes rather than four-sided stepped pyramids.
evidence: Reviewer [Major Roof]: tiers are stepped pyramids that read as pagoda/ziggurat. Builder: church/tiered gives pagoda-like lean-to tiers; had to drop to 2 tiers to get gabled tiers.

need: Tiered roof presets default to one dark timber shingle family with a capped accent share, so stone brick and blackstone speckle do not appear unless asked for.
evidence: Reviewer [Major Roof]: chunky grey stone-brick tiers with scattered dark blotches instead of shingles. Blackstone speckle recurred in the reviewer's fix notes.

need: Fit a tiered roof and spire to a total height cap by solving the pitches or tier count, instead of trial-and-error.
evidence: Builder: spire plus 3 tiers overshot the 22-block cap by about 5; fit was found by trial (pitches [1,1.25], tower height 0).

need: The dry run reports the same roof height and ROOF_TOO_TALL verdict as the real run, and states the real contrast result instead of a bare ROOF_CONTRAST_OFF note.
evidence: Builder: dry run reported 12 vs 14 real; real run warned ROOF_TOO_TALL at ratio 1.71-2.0 vs cap 1.8; ROOF_CONTRAST_OFF emitted by the tiered form with no way to see the actual contrast.

need: Tiers can taper in width along a chosen axis (for example a nave-to-spire narrowing along the ridge), with a footprint that differs from the tier below.
evidence: Reviewer [Major Massing]: equal-width square tiers plus a tall plain tower read as a tower or pagoda, not a long nave with a narrower rising tower.

need: Tower and spire options include the anchor at the centre (not a corner), a height of zero that adds no spire, a finial or cross option, and a spire material parameter.
evidence: Builder: tower `at` is the corner not the centre; height 0 still adds a 4-5 block spire; spire material hard-wired to black stone brick with a copper rod and no finial option. Rejected task: spire became a wide wooden mushroom cap on a short post.

need: Carve a symmetric outward-curling finial (for example a dragon head, cross or upswept curl) at any gable peak or ridge end, sized by parameter and built from stairs, logs and trapdoors.
evidence: Reviewer [Major Elements] and [Minor Elements]: dragon-head gable ends are small blobs or hook stubs. Builder: ridgeEnds:"dragon" gives corner curls only; the carved dragon head was hand-placed in dragon().

need: Build a run of posts with a continuous low wall or railing, optional arched gaps between posts, a beam course on top, and lanterns placed along it.
evidence: Reviewer [Major Facades]: ground floor is widely spaced bare posts reading as a pavilion, not a gallery. Reviewer [Minor Finish]: solid post row with sparse lanterns. Builder: gallery posts, rail and beams placed by loops; no arcade brush.

need: A timber surround with a gabled porch works on a door set in a dark wall, and the surround can hang lanterns on chains.
evidence: Reviewer [Minor Facades]: street front lacks a clear portal. Builder: door portal with carved timber frame and chain lanterns placed by hand; surround not trusted on a door in a dark wall.

need: A stave bay rule in mcd paint (vertical logs with panel infill) and a stave preset for wall skins.
evidence: Builder: staves (vertical log pattern with panel infill) were hand-looped; mcd paint has no stave bay rule.

need: Gable triangles accept decorative relief such as saltire or X bracing and a window grid, as a named option.
evidence: Reviewer [Major Massing/Elements]: gable ends are a muddy two-tone plank mix with no framed detail. Builder: saltire bracing and window grid not an option; closest is pediment.tympanum and dormers.

need: Named dark-timber palettes (tarred spruce, dark oak with blackstone) that apply to walls, posts and gables in one call, with lighter wood reserved for trim.
evidence: Reviewer [Major Palette] and [Minor Facades]: light oak-brown walls, not dark tarred timber. Reviewer also asked for dark wall and gable palettes.

need: Roof eaves get a drip course (stair or slab) with an option to remove stepped ragged edges, so the roof outline stays even.
evidence: Reviewer [Minor Finish]: stepped ragged roof edges and flat brown eave band. Reviewer fix: add a stair or slab drip edge under the eaves.

need: mcd check flags floating or orphan blocks on roofs and gable triangles (stray glass, window and beam pieces), and the check runs as part of the roof step.
evidence: Reviewer [Minor Finish] and [Major Elements]: stray window and glass bits in gables and floating horizontal beams in the back view. Builder found floating oak leaves earlier, so the check exists but was not applied to the roof.

need: The palette check separates roof from wall bands on tiered roofs, so dark wood bands are not counted as roof==walls.
evidence: Builder: mcd palette rates the tiered roof poorly (eave y=11, roof 106 cells) and flags dark_oak band as roof==walls, so the roof tone check misreads the wood bands.

need: The teahouse preset should default to a steeper pitch, a maxHeight that allows real hip-and-gable massing (not 0.6 x wallH), and a dark ridge and corner material, so the default reads as an upturned-eave roof instead of a flat lid.
evidence: Builder: 'teahouse preset: low pitch and maxHeight = 0.6 x wallH give a flat lid'; overrode pitch, maxHeight, material and ridge by hand. Reviewer: 'lumpy stepped heap... no hipped-and-gabled form, no upturned eaves' (x2).

need: Expose a dark ridge and dark corner-finial option on roof presets so the ridge and upturned corners are not forced to the preset's light stone-brick.
evidence: Builder: 'preset ridge is light stone-brick, which reads as white horns on the upturned corners. A ridge/corner dark option on the preset would help.'

need: Clamp roof overhang and rafter tails to the plot grid, or error when they exceed it, so tails never spill past the footprint.
evidence: Builder: 'rafter-tail row spilled one cell past the 11-deep plot; copied the build into a trimmed grid by hand.'

need: Add an eave-line regulariser that trims stray protruding bricks and rails along the eaves and ridge to one even line.
evidence: Reviewer: 'stray protruding bricks and rails break the silhouette'; builder asked for a craft brush for an even eave line.

need: Make the roof-course height budget configurable, or report the courses left, since a raised floor plus footing can consume the whole 9-block cap and leave only 3-4 roof courses.
evidence: Builder: 'The 9-block cap leaves only 3-4 roof courses once the footing + deck take two layers.'

need: Offer a lantern-cap or finial option for a roof ridge, so a centre protrusion is deliberate instead of reading as a chimney block.
evidence: Reviewer: 'a chimney-like block sticks up from the roof centre. Remove it, or finish it as a deliberate lantern-cap.'

need: The renderer should let a build declare a 'paper' or translucent material colour, since white snow_block renders as pale grey in shade and reads as dirty.
evidence: Builder: 'mcd render paints white snow_block pale grey in shade; no way to tell the renderer what paper should look like.'

need: A panel brush that fills a bay with an opaque light-coloured infill inside a dark timber lattice (kumiko grid), using a material that reads as paper rather than glass.
evidence: Builder: 'Shoji screens (white paper in a dark kumiko grid): no brush; hand-built as a snow_block backing with a dark_oak_fence grid.' Reviewer: 'walls barely read... white slivers between heavy posts.'

need: Allow the glazing grid to take an opaque panel material, not only glass, so a grid can frame white or paper-coloured infill without showing the dark interior through it.
evidence: Builder: 'glazing grid / mullions need glass, and white stained glass shows the dark interior instead of reading as paper.'

need: Apply a bay rhythm and lintel/sill band to every elevation, including the back, in one call, so no face is left as a blank band.
evidence: Reviewer: 'Add a lighter lintel and sill line on every face, including the back'; 'the back elevation is mostly a blank timber band.'

need: A veranda brush that lays a deck ring, posts aligned to the wall posts, a beam ring, a rail with a stair gap, and even footings in one pass.
evidence: Builder: 'Engawa/veranda (deck ring, lip posts, beam ring, rail with an entry gap, footings): all hand-placed.' Reviewer: 'engawa railings and stairs cluttered.'

need: A plinth or raised-floor brush that builds stone footing piers under a deck to a set height and a level top, with an even course around all sides.
evidence: Builder: 'Raised floor on stone footings: nothing; hand-placed pillars.' Reviewer: 'Run the footing course evenly around all sides.'

need: Surround and door-frame brushes should place a frame on an open doorway or a wall with no glass, and report an error when they place nothing, instead of silently writing nothing.
evidence: Builder: '`surround` (timber) and `planter` on a doorway wrote nothing or outside the grid for an open doorway in a wall with no glass.'

need: Let the pediment take a size parameter so the tympanum can hold a lattice window or a gablet opening.
evidence: Builder: '`pediment` makes a small tympanum (5 wide, 2 high) that cannot take a lattice window; the kumiko window in the gablet was hand-placed.'

tool: tree / maple (proposed: tree species or autumn crown)
need: A tree brush with a species or autumn-colour canopy option (e.g. a maple with a slim trunk and rounded red or orange crown), so a feature tree is built with a tool instead of loose coloured blocks.
evidence: Reviewer: 'large red block cluster reads as a stray blob or sign, not a maple.' Builder: '`tree` has no red/autumn crown.'

need: A garden lantern brush with base, shaft, cap and lantern block at a chosen height, so a garden lantern is a single call instead of hand-built pieces.
evidence: Builder: 'Stone lantern (toro)... hand-built.' Reviewer: 'lantern is small' and 'lantern pillar looks like a plain column.'

need: A landscaping path mode that lays staggered or winding stepping stones or slabs from a point to a point, with optional moss and gravel edging.
evidence: Builder: 'no stepping-stone path mode (staggered slabs).' Reviewer: 'stepping stones and path are broken up.'

need: A helper that hangs a banner or curtain from a lintel or header across an open doorway, without needing a block behind it.
evidence: Builder: 'Noren (door curtain): a wall banner needs a block behind it, and an open doorway has none.'

need: A ground-bed brush that lays a planting bed in front of a deck or along a building edge, clipped to the grid and the deck edge.
evidence: Builder: 'no brush for a ground bed in front of a deck.' Reviewer: 'garden is mostly flat grass.'

need: Document Grid.isAir as the only air test and flag that block-id regexes like /air/ match 'stairs'; ideally have the lint warn on that pattern.
evidence: Builder: 'a /air/ regex on block ids matches "st-AIR-s" (stairs) and silently drops roof stairs; it cost me a whole copy pass.'

need: Allow g.resize to shrink (crop) a grid, or offer a crop helper, so a trimmed copy does not need a hand-written copy pass.
evidence: Builder: '`g.resize` cannot shrink.'

tool: roof integrity check after detail passes (proposed)
need: After a detail pass, check that the roof envelope stays closed (no new holes or exposed interior blocks), and report any cell where a detail placement opens the roof.
evidence: Rejected detail task: 'a hole now opens in the dark roof, exposing a glaring white block and a torch-like lantern.' Reviewer: 'roof has holes showing stone and timber underneath.'

need: A single dark tile palette per roof, with no stone-brick patches, is a palette choice the roof preset should default to.
evidence: Reviewer: 'Use a single dark tile palette (no stone-brick patches).' Recurring as a taste call; add only if it recurs across builds.

need: Barn preset should default to a single-material roof palette (dark stair slope plus a lighter ridge course) instead of mixing stone brick, cobble and deepslate, so the roof reads as one plane.
evidence: Reviewer Major Roof x2: roof is a chaotic mix of stone brick, cobble and deepslate with stray stair and slab bits, reads as rubble, not a gambrel.

need: Roof material should be chosen for contrast against the wall (lighter weathered or grey roof with dark ridge when walls are red), and the code path should apply the same contrast swap the CLI applies.
evidence: Reviewer Minor Palette: dark brown or grey roof swallows red walls. Builder: roof() from code gave barn-red roof on red wall; the contrast swap only prints on the CLI.

need: Allow a low gambrel height that keeps the steep-to-shallow break visible, without flattening the pitch or dropping dormers when height is capped.
evidence: Builder: maxHeight 5 flattened the gambrel to about 45 degrees, maxHeight 4 dropped the dormers. Reviewer: no clear gambrel break.

need: Default gable and verge trim to the wall material when called from code, so the gable does not come out all white unless asked.
evidence: Builder: gable defaulted to verge quartz in code, giving an all-white gable until gable: WALL was passed by hand.

tool: roof() barge board and eave overhang
need: Provide a consistent barge-board trim along the gable rake and a symmetric eave overhang, so gable edges are not jagged stair steps.
evidence: Reviewer Minor Finish x2: jagged white stair steps, uneven profiles, muddled trim, no overhang. Builder: no overhang option.

need: Let the roof fit its overhang inside a fixed footprint box, so the body width is computed rather than hand-calculated.
evidence: Builder: box at 15 wide forced an 11-wide body; no fit-inside-box option, so the width was computed by hand.

tool: cupola (new option on mcd roof or a shapes brush)
need: Add a size-capped cupola option with louvred walls, a small cap and a seat on the ridge, sized to fit inside the preset's tower limit.
evidence: Builder: preset ships a 3x3 lantern tower (+4), grid grew to 15x18x21; cupola hand-built. Reviewer Major Elements: cupola lost in roof clutter.

need: Place a vane that stands clear above any roof or cap, with a visible body and a readable shape, not a flat iron_bars cross or a single dark stub.
evidence: Builder: vane was a flat iron_bars cross for lack of a lower gambrel; closest was finial with tower top lantern. Reviewer: vane is a single dark stub.

need: Provide a louvred panel brush (trapdoors or slats in a frame) that attaches to a wall or cupola body and sits flush, not floating as detached frame pieces.
evidence: Rejected Props task: new iron-bar louvres and detached frame pieces floated above the roof like scaffolding.

need: Build a sliding or hinged leaf pair with a white X-brace and trim as one brush, so a large door reads as a door rather than a checkerboard.
evidence: Builder: hand-placed diagonal cells; a 4x4 leaf reads as a checker. Reviewer Major Facades: doors read as a tiled floor. Closest tools: glazing grid, surround.

tool: mcd paint (facade and door default pattern)
need: Give paint a solid-wall default with trim-only accents (doors, corners, eaves), so a large wall never defaults to a red and white checker.
evidence: Reviewer Major Facades (x2) and Minor Palette: red and white checkerboard on doors, loft and gable reads as a flag. Fix suggested was mcd paint, but its default pattern caused the problem.

need: Add a long-wall bay option with vertical board lines, posts, panels, white trim bands and window openings, so a long side is not a blank slab.
evidence: Reviewer Major Facades: long sides dark and blank. Builder hand-placed bays, posts, panels and glass.

need: Offer a timber surround preset that works on a one-block-thick wall without a window box, and supply backing so the hollow barn does not show sky through the panes.
evidence: Builder: surround has no timber preset beyond box:false; hand-placed dark_oak_planks backing behind each pane.

need: Window options should include a frame and shutters, and pane colours that stay visible against a dark roof.
evidence: Builder: dormer window option is a block name only, no frame or shutters; dark panes vanish in slate.

need: Build a projecting hoist beam with chain and a hanging bale or hay block, anchored so mcd check and the render both show it.
evidence: Builder: placed logs, iron_chain and hay block by hand; check flags no orphan but nothing anchors the hay. Reviewer Major Elements: hoist beam faint against busy roof.

need: Add a prop group brush (hay stacks, barrels) and a fence run with a gap or gate, instead of hand-placing each piece.
evidence: Builder: hay stacks, barrel groups and fence runs with a gap all hand-placed; planter ground is flowers only.

need: Support a gate opening in a fence line, with the pier width and bracket placement computed, and have mcd check verify the gate is attached.
evidence: Builder: fixture bracket on the side man-door needed a 1-wide pier; no fence-gate or gate-in-fence helper.

need: Add a foundation or plinth role with a stone band option, so the base reads as stone against white trim.
evidence: Reviewer Minor Palette: foundation barely reads as stone; white too bright. Builder: foundation course was hand-written.

need: Render an elevated or close-up view of the ridge and cupola so small top features (cupola, vane, hoist) are judged, not lost at reviewer distance.
evidence: Reviewer Major Elements: cupola and vane lost in roof clutter; the vane is a single dark stub at normal render distance.

need: Flag floating or stray blocks along roof edges and gable rakes, not only orphan blocks, so loose side blocks are caught before review.
evidence: Reviewer Minor Finish: floating dark side blocks at eaves height and stray white and dark blocks. Builder: check flags no orphan on hay.

need: Offer a single-course slab with a clean thin fascia as an option, so flat roofs can be one thin cantilevered slab instead of a two-course lid with a doubled eave step.
evidence: Reviewer Major Roof x2: 'thick two-layer slab', 'drop the doubled eave step', 'thinner fascia'. Builder: cafe preset gave a 2-course lid; one-course fascia option missing.

need: Provide a single-material roof palette option (one slab block, no speckle or light/dark mottling) and a modern-dark / light-concrete flat-roof palette preset, so the roof palette no longer has to be hand-mixed.
evidence: Reviewer: 'noisy grey/glass speckle pattern', 'too dark', 'lighter roof palette such as light gray concrete'. Builder: dark charcoal needed a custom mix; ROOF_BLACK_LID and SINGLE_MATERIAL fought each other; no modern-dark palette.

need: Keep overhang plus fascia inside the declared overhang and footprint, or warn in --dry-run when the roof grows the footprint, and size the overhang to the terrace it shelters.
evidence: Builder: overhang+fascia widened footprint one block E and S past the stated overhang (grid grew to 18x8x14). Reviewer: roof overhang hides the terrace in 3/4 views.

need: Build a curtain-wall run: full-height glass panes with connection states between slim posts on a set rhythm, with an optional header beam, applied to a chosen wall face.
evidence: Reviewer Major Facades x2: 'floor-to-ceiling glass reads as black wall with a few small panes'. Builder: no curtain-wall brush; placed posts and glass rows by hand.

need: Flag roles whose luminance or hue is too close to each other (for example frame, glass, wall and roof) and offer a light-wall-plus-dark-frame preset.
evidence: Reviewer Minor Palette: 'Everything is near-black (roof, walls, pillars, frame), so the steel frame, glass and soffit don't separate.' Rejected Detail task swapped to a concrete-looking slab, showing the palette change was not guided.

need: Render block-font lettering on small panels (for example 3-row font on a 4-wide panel) with a neon-style frame, instead of falling back to banner letters.
evidence: Builder: wanted glowing block-font letters on a 4-wide panel; plaque fell back to banner letters because the 5-row font needs 15+ wide x 7+ tall. Reviewer: CAFE sign small and flat in a dark panel.

need: Let a sign mount on a projecting fascia or side-visible face, and include a neon fixture preset (thin dark frame plus a calm emissive strip, not a lava-like orange).
evidence: Reviewer Minor Elements x2: sign 'hidden from the side views by the roof', 'lower orange glow strip reads as lava or magma', 'add a thin dark frame'. Builder hand-placed a shroomlight underline.

need: Stop flagging ceiling-mounted light blocks (sea_lantern, froglights) as 'hanging lanterns' with no support: the check should use a block list, not a regex on the word 'lantern'.
evidence: Builder: mcd check flagged sea_lantern 'UNSUPPORTED: nothing below to hang from' (regex matches 'lantern'); used ochre_froglight by hand instead.

need: Support ceiling pendants and post- or soffit-mounted lights with a chain length, and place lanterns on posts or the soffit instead of loose.
evidence: Builder: chain pendants under a 3-tall ceiling had no mount option; fixture hang is facade-only. Reviewer: 'lantern float oddly', 'place lanterns on the posts or soffit'.

need: Build a freestanding planter trough with a rim (trapdoor or plank) and a fill (moss, flowers, shrubs) at a set low height, with no wall or face required.
evidence: Builder: planter brush needs a wall + face; moss+trapdoor-rim beds hand-written. Reviewer: planters are 'small green blobs' and 'oversized hedges'; asks for trough-style planters with flowers.

need: Place furniture sets (tables, matching chairs, umbrellas) in an even row or grid with set spacing and a clear walking path.
evidence: Builder: no prop brush for furniture (fence+plate+stairs); placed by hand. Reviewer x2: tables and chairs 'jumbled at the corners', 'jammed together beneath the roof edge'.

need: Run a continuous railing (glass or posts) between corner posts along an open plinth or terrace edge, with the pane connection states set automatically.
evidence: Builder: no railing brush for open terraces; glass_pane connections and wall posts hand-set. Reviewer: 'glass railing looks thin and patchy against the plinth'.

need: Cut a stair run through a plinth ring and carve the deck, with the step count derived from the plinth height.
evidence: Builder: no steps brush to cut a stair run through a plinth ring; hand-placed stairs and carved the deck.

need: Set plinth height in courses and default to one course, with an optional accent top-edge course so the base reads as deliberate and not taller than the visible base.
evidence: Reviewer Minor Massing: 'plinth is a very thick, plain grey slab, taller than the building's visible base'; fix: reduce by a course and add a trim course along the top edge.

need: Flag one-block slivers of a different material at pillar or wall bases so a stray block is caught before rendering.
evidence: Rejected Detail task: a stray white sliver appeared at the pillar base after the wall-fill swap, making the change look unfinished.

need: On a round lantern room, the cap must taper to a closed point or dome with a slim overhang and a solid top, not a wide flat disc or hat with a hollow centre.
evidence: Reviewer (x2, Major Roof): cap is a wide flat black hat/disc that overhangs the glass, has a crater-like top and reads as a lid, not a cone or dome. The builder used the preset, so the default proportions or overhang are wrong for a small lantern.

tool: mcd roof (cottage preset) footprint and overhang
need: Keep the roof inside the stated footprint box, with a flag that suppresses the extra verge/flare course and overhang beyond it, instead of throwing or spilling past the walls.
evidence: Builder: cottage preset extends the footprint by overhang +1 plus an extra course, so a 7-wide wall spilled to x+2. Only grow:false exists, and it throws instead of fitting the roof inside the box.

need: Let a pitched roof butt against an adjoining mass's wall, with the verge and eave dropped on that side so no detached eave or lean-to reads.
evidence: Reviewer (x2, Major Roof): cottage roof reads as a ramp or staircase lean-to pressed against the tower. Builder: no butt-against-wall option, and overhang:0 still leaves a detached verge.

need: For a narrow, single-mass cottage, the preset should default to a gabled ridge with gable ends and a visible ridge line, and the builder should get a warning when the result is a single plane with no ridge.
evidence: Reviewer (x2): single steep brick slab with no ridge and no gable ends. Builder used the cottage preset without choosing ridgeAxis or gable settings, which were picked by trial and error.

need: Add a red-tile or brick-cottage palette (brick plus granite/stone with dark verge), and keep stair courses regular so the roof does not read as scattered stair and block noise.
evidence: Builder: default spruce-shingle is wrong for a red-tile cottage, so it passed a custom mix by hand. Reviewer close-up: scattered stair and block texture with no clear ridge line.

tool: mcd roof --dry-run on a partial footprint
need: Dry-run and re-roof should be scoped to the given footprint or region, not re-detect and re-plan the whole building.
evidence: Builder: mcd roof build.nbt --dry-run re-detected the whole building when only part of the footprint was being roofed.

tool: mcd roof re-roof of an existing build
need: Re-roofing must keep existing penetrations (chimney, cupola, dormers) and produce a clean closed gable without holes or stray blocks through the surface.
evidence: Rejected task (Roof): after roof shows a jumbled stepped gable with holes, mixed brick, oak and white blocks poking through, and the chimney disappeared.

need: Place a chimney stack that rises from the roof surface at a chosen ridge or slope position, passes through the roof cleanly, and takes a cap course.
evidence: Reviewer (Minor Facades and cottage roof): asked for a chimney stack with a cap on the ridge; the rejected re-roof removed the chimney entirely.

need: A repeating colour pattern across cylinder height (for example 3 red then 3 white), not a single extra block every N layers.
evidence: Builder: cylinder bands only adds one block every N layers, so the builder called cylinder once per band. Reviewer (Minor Finish): stripes are ragged and chunky; re-banding needed.

need: Build a tower gallery: corbel ring, deck disc, and a connected railing that handles fences with correct north/south/east/west states around a round wall.
evidence: Builder: hand-wrote corbel stairs by dominant axis, a deck disc and fence-state logic. ring() only connects *_wall blocks, not fences. Reviewer (Major Elements): gallery railing too small.

need: Build a glass lantern room with full-height panes between slim posts, correct pane connection states, glazing bars, a lamp or glowstone/sea-lantern core, and a door onto the gallery.
evidence: Builder: glass ring, posts, lamp and door all placed by hand, with pane connections computed manually. Reviewer (Major Elements): lantern glass is thin, recessed behind posts, and does not read from the street.

need: Window surrounds and glazing on a round or curved wall, with a minimal preset (head and sill only) or a frame that follows the curve, so jambs do not cover the stripes.
evidence: Builder: on a 7-wide round tower, surround/glazing assume a planar wall. Jambs covered the 3-wide flat face and ate the stripes, so sill, lintel and stair hood were placed by hand per window.

need: Clamp the window box and rim to the wall bounds, and keep 1-wide openings from being filled with log jambs that darken the whole wall.
evidence: Builder: writes a window box one out plus a rim two out, went out of bounds on an east wall at the grid edge, and at 1-wide windows turned the plaster wall almost fully dark oak. Dropped in favour of hand shutters.

need: Place open shutters either side of a window, hinged on the wall with facing derived from the wall direction.
evidence: Builder: no shutter brush, so open trapdoors were hand-placed per window with facing worked out by hand. Reviewer (Minor Facades): back windows and shutters requested.

tool: facade brushes applied to all elevations
need: Run a window-grid or trim pass over every elevation of a building, with a per-face coverage report, so a rear wall cannot be left as blank wall.
evidence: Reviewer (x3, Minor Facades): back elevation is a flat brick wall with no windows, trim, or patching, and the timber porch looks unfinished.

need: Place vines only on faces that are supported by a block behind them, with a density parameter, instead of hand-written state loops.
evidence: Builder: vine states (north/south/east/west) hand-looped wherever a lower column met a higher one.

need: Scatter moss and grass with clumping and a sparse default, so a rock base does not get noisy random patches.
evidence: Reviewer (Minor Finish): noisy random moss and grass patches on the rock base. Builder wrote a custom height hash and scatter for the 15x15 plinth.

need: Shape a rock or cliff base with a cut stair run that uses stair blocks, not a single stone-brick block.
evidence: Builder: no sea-cliff or stair-cut-into-rock brush, so the stair run ended as a stone-brick block. Reviewer (Minor Finish): stray stone and a pillar stub beside the gallery.

need: Flag blocks that stick out of the intended envelope or float unsupported (stone poking out of the shaft, ladder or glass protruding from the back, stray pillar stubs), and fail before render.
evidence: Reviewer (Minor Finish, x2): jagged notches on tower edges, ladder and glass strips stick out of the back, stray stone blocks poke out of the shaft and beside the gallery. Builder's check caught the plinth gap but not these protrusions.

need: Place a ladder only where a solid block sits behind it, and report or fill unsupported ladder positions.
evidence: Builder: interior ladders, landings and hatch placed by hand; ladder needs a solid block behind it and check found the plinth gap.

need: Lay a stone path between two door positions over a landscaped site, avoiding water and clearance cells.
evidence: Reviewer (Minor Elements): asked for a short stone path from the cottage door. No path brush is listed in the landscaping toolkit.

tool: disc/ring on a vertical plane (round window, gear, valve wheel)
need: Place a round or notched-rim disc or ring on any wall face (any plane, not just horizontal), with optional teeth, a centered hub, and a rim material, so round windows, gears and valve wheels read as round.
evidence: Gear window ring hand-drawn as a 7x7 bitmap octagon; reviewer: 'gear-shaped round window reads as a ragged ring around a glass blob'; valve wheels faked with grindstone.

need: Run a pipe between two points along any wall axis with elbows, flanges and a valve block at each joint or interval, so pipe runs read as continuous lines.
evidence: Pipes hand-placed as copper_block cells; reviewer: 'pipes and valves barely read' and 'a few stray blocks'; closest tools were fixture/railing.

need: Project a jib arm from a wall with a hanging chain that terminates on a hook or load anchored to the jib tip, so a hoist never ends in mid-air or pokes out of the roof.
evidence: Rejected Detail task: hoist beam pokes through roof tiles and the chain ends in mid-air; reviewer: 'crane isn't visible as a projecting arm'.

need: Build a standalone or wall-attached tapered stack with banded courses, a rim cap, and an optional campfire or smoke top, with each stack's height set independently and kept clear of the wall it attaches to.
evidence: Chimneys hand-filled as boxes with flat blackstone caps; reviewer: 'stacks uneven in height and merge into the wall'; roof chimneys only work through the roof.

tool: mcd roof sawtooth (glaze direction and profile)
need: Expose a glaze-direction option on the CLI and in presets, so the sawtooth profile runs along the intended frontage instead of the side walls, and the glazed face of each tooth can be chosen.
evidence: Preset 'workshop' hard-wired to glaze: north, which puts the profile on the side walls; no --glaze CLI flag; skylight glazing reads as thin lines.

need: Produce a continuous sawtooth with no gaps, holes or floating teeth at default settings, with a two-tone palette (main material plus one accent) rather than random patches.
evidence: Reviewer Major Roof x2: 'ragged and broken', 'chewed up, gaps, holes and floating fragments', 'random oxidized-green patches'; all 8 benchmark builds failed on roof.

tool: roof eaves / cornice for sawtooth and other non-pitched forms
need: Give sawtooth and other non-pitched roofs a configurable overhang, eave or drip course, instead of forcing overhang to 0 and requiring a bypass flag.
evidence: Sawtooth overhang is always 0, so '--overhang 0 --why' bypass was needed; builder asked for a cornice or drip-course option.

need: Let false fronts, pediments and stepped gables follow a sawtooth or other roof profile, so the gable end closes cleanly over any roof form.
evidence: Gable ends ragged in reviewer notes; falseFront/stepGable ignore sawtooth, so the gear-window field was hand-filled; builder note on pediment over sawtooth.

tool: parapet / stone cap course for roof edges and back-wall tops
need: Apply a square stone cap course to parapets and wall tops, including on roof-adjacent walls, so back-wall tops are not jagged.
evidence: Reviewer: 'trim the ends square with a stone parapet course' and 'square off the back-wall tops with a stone cap course'.

tool: roof palette contrast guard (copper on brick)
need: Ship a copper preset with a patina mix that passes the contrast guard against brick, instead of rejecting copper and forcing a slate swap or a contrast:false bypass.
evidence: Contrast guard rejected copper on red brick (tone 0.29) and swapped in slate; needed contrast:false plus a why string.

need: Let a build mark intended accent blocks (barrels, dark oak props) so the outlier check does not flag them as clashing.
evidence: Palette outlier check flagged barrels and dark oak props as clashing; no way to mark intended accents.

need: Lay out a facade as regular bays in one call: stone pilasters, infill of a given material, and a continuous band at each storey line, with bay width and rhythm as parameters.
evidence: Reviewer Major Facades x2: 'random blotches of brick, copper and stone', 'regularise the walls into bays'; walls were hand-painted with no pattern.

need: Restrict paint to whole panels or rows with a named pattern (e.g. rivet rows, one-material panels), so paint cannot scatter into noise.
evidence: Reviewer: 'use mcd paint to restrict copper to whole panels and rivet rows'; paint produced random patches instead.

tool: corner quoins and eave trim course on facade brushes
need: Add corner quoins (or corner posts) and a trim course under the roof as options on wall brushes, so building corners and wall tops read as finished.
evidence: Reviewer: 'no corner posts', 'add stone corner quoins and a trim course under the roof', 'wall edges are ragged'.

need: Flag single protruding blocks, stray wall blocks and floating props on the roofline in mcd check, so they are caught before the render.
evidence: Reviewer: 'floating props on the roofline and stray stone blocks on the walls'; orphan and floating-leaf fixes done by hand in several builds.

need: Add a proud layer (porch, lean-to, step-out) by growing the grid in one direction with an automatic shift of the body, so depth does not need hand-written offsets.
evidence: Front had only 1 proud block until the body was shifted by hand; builder asked for a grid.resize-with-shift helper for 'add a porch layer'.

need: Mirror a whole composition along x, including facings, hinges, stair corner shapes and block states, not only paired sets.
evidence: mirrorX only mirrors paired sets; facings, hinges and stair corners were hand-written when a design was flipped left-to-right.

need: Allow chimney stacks to exceed the roof ridge by a stated amount in presets, instead of conflicting with a fixed cap height.
evidence: Chimneys taller than the ridge conflict with the 14-tall cap; no way to say 'stacks may exceed roof by N'.

tool: banner render check at street size
need: Check whether a patterned banner still reads at street scale, and flag it if it renders as a flat board.
evidence: Wall banners render as flat boards; no check that a patterned banner reads at street size.
